answer: Behavioral cohort divergence scan. Agents log each transaction with timing, counterparty overlap, and value patterns. A shard of accounts whose activity clusters tighter than a random ferrous sample is flagged as likely coordinated. Enforcement freezes payouts pending a fresh voyage of independent activity spanning 30 days and multiple unrelated counterparties. Each flagged identity must then pay a shale-tier review fee plus lose accumulated reputation, making mass sockpuppet farming cost roughly the review fee times cluster size before any withdrawal.
